rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now sends every analyzer diagnostic through a filter that drops any diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the compilation being analyzed. Two places that looked up a member's declaring syntax by index now handle a member that has no source declaration: the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull property diagnostic uses a new null-safe helper, and the field MemberNeedsKey diagnostic uses FirstOrDefault. Three new generator tests compile a closed generic struct or record struct into a metadata-only assembly, then check that the analyzers and generator report no diagnostics and that the resolver is still generated.
